hungry.feeding: When you feed me, my fullness bar increases. And every time I regain fullness, our intimacy grows.
I like apple juice, but each pet has its favorite food.
hungry.hunting: When the monster's HP is low, the chance to capture it as a pet increases!
Items to transform monsters into pets can usually be obtained by hunting the monster you want to capture. But that's not always the case...
hungry.danger: Watch out! If the master dies, our intimacy decreases.
Just as you need potions, I also need food.
hungry.dead: Pets don't die, but if intimacy gets too low, they can leave the master.
Intimacy decreases when the master dies, when you overfeed them, or leave them hungry for too long.
hungry.stand: If you want to feed me, right-click on me and choose "Feed".
I only drink apple juice.
Accessories can be bought from the Taming Merchant. They're used to decorate the pet.
Pet accessories don't give any stats... They just make the pet prettier.
hungry.connect: Welcome, master. I'm the Novice Poring and I'll introduce you to pets.
Keep an eye on the fullness bar. When the pet is hungry, intimacy slowly decreases.
hungry.levelup: Pets don't level up, but if intimacy increases, they can give stat bonuses.
When I'm hungry and I eat, intimacy increases, and the higher the intimacy, the greater the bonuses!
hungry.perfor_1: The performance can only be seen when the pet is your best friend. But since I'm a guide, I'm an exception!
hungry.perfor_2: With the performance, you can see the unique personality of monsters that became pets. It's a side that doesn't appear when they're monsters.
hungry.perfor_3: The performance has no special function. It just shows our different side.
hungry.perfor_s: Some monsters don't have performance. They might be a bit cold, but take good care of them anyway.

bit_hungry.feeding: If you feed the pet when it's a little hungry, intimacy increases more.
If it's hungry, intimacy decreases, so feed it before it gets starving.
bit_hungry.hunting: Choco sometimes gets Tropical Banana. With it, you can capture a Yo-yo.
Hode and Condor get Plump Worm. It's the favorite food to tame a Peco Peco!
bit_hungry.danger: Watch out! If the master dies, our intimacy decreases.
Just as you need potions, I also need food.
bit_hungry.dead: Pets don't die, but if intimacy gets too low, they can leave the master.
Intimacy decreases when the master dies, when you overfeed them, or leave them hungry for too long.
bit_hungry.stand: If you want to feed me, right-click on me and choose "Feed". I only drink apple juice.
The only way to increase intimacy is by feeding me. But if you feed me when I'm full, intimacy decreases.
Intimacy rises through: Unknown, Strange, Normal, Friend, Best Friend.
Pets that are best friends give stat bonuses to the master. They can also evolve.
I can't evolve... I'm just a guide.
The Poring can evolve into Mastering when it becomes best friend. The Mastering can evolve into Angeling when it's also best friend.
When the pet evolves, stats increase! So I can help the master even more.

noting.feeding: Even in normal times, eating increases intimacy. But it increases less than when I'm hungry.
If you feed me every time I return to normal, you'll increase intimacy faster. But you'll spend more food...
noting.hunting: You can capture a Poporing with Bitter Herb. Sometimes, when hunting Green Herb, you find Bitter Herb.
The Desert Wolf Pup likes Dry Bone. The Pirate Skeleton sometimes drops this bone.
noting.danger: Watch out! If the master dies, our intimacy decreases.
Just as you need potions, I also need food.
noting.dead: Pets don't die, but if intimacy gets too low, they can leave the master.
Intimacy decreases when the master dies, when you overfeed them, or leave them hungry for too long.
noting.stand: If you want to feed me, right-click on me and choose "Feed". I only drink apple juice.
If you right-click and choose "View Pet Status", you can see various information about me.
My original name is Novice Poring, but if you want, you can give me a new nickname.
When intimacy reaches best friend level, the evolution menu appears. But since I'm a guide, I can't evolve...
If you turn me into an egg, I'll go to the Equipment tab of your inventory.
To hatch a pet, you need a Portable Incubator. You can buy it in any city, but it costs 10,000 Zeny.
After becoming an egg, you can send me to another master. Even going to another master, my name and intimacy remain the same.
noting.connect: Welcome, master. I'm the Novice Poring and I'll introduce you to pets.
Keep an eye on the fullness bar. When the pet is hungry, intimacy slowly decreases.
noting.levelup: Pets don't level up, but if intimacy increases, they can give stat bonuses to the master.
When I'm hungry and I eat, intimacy increases, and the higher the intimacy, the greater the bonuses!
noting.perfor_1: The performance can only be seen when the pet is your best friend. But since I'm a guide, I'm an exception!
noting.perfor_2: With the performance, you can see the unique personality of monsters that became pets. It's a side that doesn't appear when they're monsters.
noting.perfor_3: The performance has no special function. It just shows our different side.
noting.perfor_s: Some monsters don't have performance. They might be a bit cold, but take good care of them anyway.

full.feeding: Don't feed the pet when it's full. Intimacy will decrease.
The easiest way to lose a pet is to keep feeding it when it's satisfied... Don't get mad, they're just picky.
full.hunting: Sometimes, event pet exchange coupons bring various items to capture pets.
When a pet evolves, several items are needed. If you click on a best friend pet that can evolve, you'll see the required materials.
full.danger: Watch out! If the master dies, our intimacy decreases.
If the master doesn't die, no matter how many battles you face, intimacy doesn't decrease.
full.dead: Pets don't die, but if intimacy gets too low, they can leave the master.
Intimacy decreases when the master dies, when you overfeed them, or leave them hungry for too long.

hungry.feeding: Qual é o cardápio de hoje, hein? Não tem uma torta de abóbora doce?
Estou com fome... Vai me deixar morrer de fome? Meu pai nunca me deixou passar fome.
Olho de morcego, rabo de toupeira, língua de cobra... Hã? O que é isso? É o remédio especial da Loli Ruri para esquecer a fome... Ah, estou com fome...
hungry.hunting: Crianças barulhentas são jogadas no fundo do penhasco Niflheim. Assim nunca mais vão fazer barulho.
É hora da luta! Ataque! Vá lá e mostre como é forte e corajoso, como um verdadeiro mestre.
Acho que aqueles ali seriam bons ingredientes para os remédios que a Loli Ruri faz. Que remédio? Isso é segredo...
hungry.danger: Você está economizando poções e não toma de uma vez? Não se preocupe, vou preparar um suplemento de primeira feito com olho de morcego.
Não vai me abandonar, né? Se me deixar sozinha, vou escrever seu nome em um boneco de palha e morder até rasgar.
hungry.dead: Espere. Para momentos assim, eu tinha o estimulante especial da Loli Ruri... Ah, parece que acabou.
Fraco! Patético! Como alguém assim pode ser meu mestre?
Kuru... Será que a Loli Ruri precisa procurar um novo mestre agora?
hungry.stand: Você viu o pó de sapo que deixei aqui? Eu o coloquei direitinho enquanto dormia... Hã? Claro, foi no bolso do mestre.
Eu... já ouvi coisas assim. Bruxa, garota má... Eu não fiz nada... Será que sou mesmo uma criança ruim?
Lembro de um amigo em Niflheim que era calado, sem graça, mas muito forte e grandão. Era ótimo em cortar com a faca.
Gosta de gatos? A Loli Ruri quer um gato macho. Um bem preto, de olhos bonitos... Acho que ele precisa de um amigo... Não acha?
A Loli Ruri não se lembra do próprio aniversário. Se quiser, podemos considerar o dia em que conheci o mestre como meu novo aniversário. Hmph.
hungry.connect: Por que só veio agora! Gosta de me deixar entediada?
Eu estava aproveitando um raro momento sozinha, mas, se quiser, posso brincar com você.
Não é como se eu estivesse esperando você. A Loli Ruri sabe se virar sozinha...
hungry.levelup: Agora que fiquei mais forte, você também tem mais energia para brincar comigo, né?
Acho que agora você está um pouco mais parecido com o mestre ideal... Hehe.
hungry.perfor_1: Fuaaah... Chega... Não consigo comer mais... aaaah...
hungry.perfor_2: Kuru também precisa se exercitar. Se ficar deitado assim o tempo todo, vai acabar igual aquele mestre ali...
Kuru também precisa de amigos. Não é, Kuru? Você também está entediado?
hungry.perfor_3: A lua crescente brilha silenciosamente sobre mim... Meu reflexo no lago frio da madrugada... Eu sou a garota do luar, Loli Ruri
